name: Tabs
description: Pill-style tabs for switching between views or filtering content. Features a subtle container background with solid primary-colored active tab.
usage: Use for switching between mutually exclusive views or content sections
Prefer over SegmentedControl when you want a pill-in-container visual style
Use size='compact' for dense UIs, 'sm' for secondary contexts, 'md' (default) for primary navigation
Supports keyboard navigation with arrow keys, Home, and End
Always provide meaningful labels for accessibility
design: Inactive tabs use --color-text-default with hover state --color-state-hover
Container has rounded-lg corners, individual tabs have rounded-md
accessibility: Uses role='tablist' on container and role='tab' on each tab button
tabIndex roving focus: only active tab is in tab order
Arrow keys navigate between tabs, Home/End jump to first/last
Disabled tabs have aria-disabled and are skipped during keyboard navigation
Optional label prop provides accessible name for the tablist

props.name: tabs
props.description: Array of tab items with value, label, and optional disabled flag

props.name: size
props.description: Size variant controlling height and typography

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes for the container element

subcomponents.name: TabItem
subcomponents.description: Type definition for individual tab items

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether this specific tab is disabled
